title: Reentry Trust Network OS
tagline: Turn lived survival knowledge into a compliance-and-resource system that reentry orgs pay for and parolees actually use.

executable_output.summary: A working SMS check-in bot backend (Flask + Twilio webhook) and the complete Postgres schema to run it on Supabase today -- deployable within a single afternoon using only free-tier services.

artifacts.content:
-- Reentry Trust Network OS core schema (Postgres/Supabase)

CREATE EXTENSION IF NOT EXISTS "uuid-ossp";

CREATE TABLE org (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  plan TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'free' CHECK (plan IN ('free','pro','enterprise')),
  seats INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE app_user (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  phone TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  zip_code TEXT,
  streak_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  org_id UUID REFERENCES org(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE check_in (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  user_id UUID NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('on_time','missed','needs_help')),
  note TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE resource (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT uuid_generate_v4(),
  category TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (category IN ('housing','job','id_docs','food','legal','mental_health')),
  zip_code TEXT NOT NULL,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  contact TEXT NOT NULL,
  verified BOOLEAN NOT NULL DEFAULT false
);

CREATE INDEX idx_resource_zip_cat ON resource(zip_code, category);
CREATE INDEX idx_checkin_user ON check_in(user_id);

-- Aggregate view for org dashboard (no PII exposed beyond phone hash)
CREATE VIEW org_outcomes AS
SELECT
  u.org_id,
  COUNT(*) AS total_checkins,
  SUM(CASE WHEN c.status='on_time' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::float / COUNT(*) AS on_time_rate,
  AVG(u.streak_count) AS avg_streak
FROM check_in c
JOIN app_user u ON u.id = c.user_id
WHERE u.org_id IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY u.org_id;
